question: In which part of the IC engine are the cylinder liners fitted?
solution:
The correct answer is __Cylinder block__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cylinder liners__ are critical components of an IC engine.
 
• The cylinder liners are fitted into the cylinder block, providing a wear-resistant surface.
 
• They serve to prevent direct contact between the piston and the cylinder block.
 
• Cylinder liners are designed to withstand high pressure, temperature, and friction during the engine's operation.
 
• They can be made of materials such as cast iron or advanced alloys for durability.
 
• The liners help ensure efficient combustion and reduce wear and tear.
 
• Proper maintenance of cylinder liners can extend the life of the engine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Crankcase:**
 
 
• The crankcase is the housing for the crankshaft in the IC engine.
 
• It also contains the lubricating oil used for engine operation.
 
 
 
• **Cylinder Head:**
 
 
• The cylinder head is located at the top of the cylinder block.
 
• It houses components such as valves, spark plugs, and injectors.
 
 
 
• **Piston:**
 
 
• The piston moves up and down within the cylinder, enabling the engine to convert pressure into mechanical energy.
 
• It is connected to the crankshaft via a connecting rod.
